the histogram mean is robust to changes in acquisition and reconstruction conditions, and that the GLCM features vary in their robustness to these changes.
density and texture features are not robust to acquisition and reconstruction variations, but there are some exceptions.

The main takeaway from our work is that
care should be taken in comparing results across different conditions and that a measure such as Q should be used to assess robustness of features across conditions.
density features, such as mean, median, standard deviation, and variance, are relatively robust to changes in acquisition and reconstruction conditions, whereas texture features are not.
